crossRefs.note: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Mushi
people.line: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.

translations.web: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
translations.bsb: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
translations.asv: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
